joystick._comment: task command (cart frame) while L1 is held; first-test limits, training range is vx -0.6..0.9, vy 0.25, wz 0.6

camera._cam_rpy_comment: camera link in torso_link, rad; default = g1.urdf d435_joint (0, 0.8308, 0). Measure your D455 mount.

hands._comment: Dex-3 targets for hand_control (left 7, right 7: thumb 0-2, middle 0-1, index 0-1). 'fist' = hand_control's own closed default; 'fit' = the V7 simulated grasp on the 22 mm bar
